summary: For each successful estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2, publish the pallet width, height, and depth in metres on the outcome and on PalletPoseStamped. Width and height are taken in the prototype axes after the chamfer pose this depth frame already produced. Shift obs_points_2d by minus best_pose.tx and best_pose.ty, then rotate by minus best_pose.theta_rad. The silhouette width is the max-minus-min on the prototype width axis, and the silhouette height is the max-minus-min on the prototype height axis. The published width is the greater of that silhouette width and params.pallet_width_m, and the published height is the greater of that silhouette height and params.pallet_height_m. A face this capture shows beyond the factory 1.20 m by 0.14 m keeps the larger measured side, and a crop that falls short stays the factory face the match used, so a partial plane is not published as a smaller pallet. Depth is the fork opening behind that same face. The face-centre range stays the pose position. The pose already places two pockets with pocket_width_m, pocket_height_m, and pocket_centre_offset_m. Among the samples from sample_face_points whose plane projection falls inside either pocket, keep those whose signed plane distance lies on the far side of the camera-facing normal by more than plane_inlier_threshold_m. orient_normal_toward_camera makes that far side the negative signed distance; the stored length is its absolute value. depth_m is the median of those lengths, so one farther return does not set the opening, and a point in the detection box outside the pockets is not included. When no pocket sample is on that far side, has_body_depth is false and depth_m is not given as 0; width_m and height_m are still published. When the set is nonempty, has_body_depth is true. The user named the three sizes. The part they did not name is that a short silhouette does not shrink the factory face, and that depth is the median far-side length inside the pockets the match already placed. A failed estimate publishes no PalletPoseStamped. The two early returns in on_pair stay silent. Stage 2 still runs once, on the one candidate select_detection already chooses. The rich message already carries this pair's RGB and depth stamps, so the sizes belong to this capture while the scene can still change.
hypothesis: The face centre and yaw are already on PalletPoseStamped, while the pocket rectangles and the plane inliers exist only inside estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 and are dropped on return. Writing the face size this capture's silhouette supports, without shrinking a crop below the matched factory face, and writing the pocket opening's median far-side length when the body is visible behind that face, gives the handling process the pallet width, height, and depth for the pallet this synchronized capture is about to approach.
